statement: The profile provides a DCAT-AP-conformant representation of geospatial metadata.
The profile provides an RDF representation of geospatial metadata that is as comprehensive as possible and avoids semantic loss.
The profile promotes the cross-domain reuse of geospatial metadata.
The profile includes, at least, all mandatory DCAT-AP elements.
The profile uses vocabularies other than DCAT-AP only for geospatial metadata elements that DCAT-AP does not support.
The profile bases its alignments as far as possible on existing practice, in particular the working group's experience.
The profile avoids a negative impact on existing implementations.
The profile defines new terms only when existing vocabularies offer no suitable candidate, and only after careful assessment.
The profile discards new terms that could conflict with standards under preparation.
The profile covers all metadata elements of the core profile of ISO 19115.
The profile covers the INSPIRE metadata elements, leaving out only those not common to all INSPIRE spatial data themes.
The profile excludes only optional elements.
The profile offers an RDF syntax binding as an additional way to implement and publish INSPIRE/ISO metadata on DCAT-AP-conformant portals.
The profile leaves the INSPIRE metadata regulation and technical guidelines, and the collections maintained under them, unchanged.

The syntax binding supports the conversion of ISO 19115/INSPIRE metadata records into the RDF representation; conversion back is not required.
The profile keeps its RDF syntax binding as simple as possible.
The profile reuses the published alignments between EuroVoc, GEMET and the INSPIRE themes.
The GeoDCAT-AP working group feeds recommendations into the DCAT-AP revision so that DCAT-AP and GeoDCAT-AP stay aligned.
